title: Mysql vulnerabilities advisory
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-274.012820: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – MySQL VULNERABILITIES ADVISORY
leadParagraph: Multiple security issues were discovered in MySQL and this update includes new upstream MySQL versions to fix these issues.
contentHtml:
Multiple security issues were discovered in MySQL and this update includes new upstream MySQL versions to fix these issues.

MySQL has been updated to 8.0.19 in Ubuntu 19.10. Ubuntu 16.04 LTS and Ubuntu 18.04 LTS have been updated to MySQL 5.7.29.

In addition to security fixes, the updated packages contain bug fixes, new features, and possibly incompatible changes.

TT-CSIRT encourages users and administrators to review and apply the necessary updates.

  • https://usn.ubuntu.com/4250-1/
  • https://dev.mysql.com/doc/relnotes/mysql/5.7/en/news-5-7-29.html
  • https://dev.mysql.com/doc/relnotes/mysql/8.0/en/news-8-0-19.html
  • https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cpujan2020.html
